title: Allow player to walk behind a section of wall

posts.author: OmegaFallon
posts.body: Hello! This is my first post here and I'm new to using RPG Maker. I've hit a few bumps in the road but this is the first one I haven't been able to solve by searching through forums and tutorials. I have this section of wall/ceiling tile (boxed in red) that I want the player to be able to walk behind. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be possible to set walls to star passability in the tileset editor, and Yanfly's Region Restrictions only lets me walk on top of the tiles, not beneath them as I'd like to. I saw a post about using Grid-Free Doodads, but in the replies people seemed to see the whole solution as unnecessary? I'm generally a bit confused here. I feel like there ought to be a simple solution to this that I'm just missing. Any help is greatly appreciated, thank you very much!

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
There's an NRP plugin for this. The plugin file has English instructions
オートタイル（壁・屋根）の上部だけを通行可能に【RPGツクールMZ&MVプラグイン】 - New RPG Project
There's also this

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: The plugin solutions are probably the easiest. You could also make copies of the ceilings, have them as tiles on your other sheets, with star passability and no down passage.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
If I were you, I would use layer D for the top of the walls.
Your map looks pretty normal to me, no tall characters and oversized events, so a simple layer plus star tiles can solve the problem.
It is not nice but it works.
